newsitem.title: USA: Royale Investments sees higher '97 FFO.
newsitem.headline: Royale Investments sees higher '97 FFO.

text.p: Royale Investments Inc, a real estate investment trust, said it targets funds from operations in 1997 of $944,000 or $0.665 per share compared to $847,000 or $0.60 per share in 1996.

The real estate investment trust also said it projects a 1997 yearend net income of $377,000, a 28.8 percent increase over the 1996 net income of $293,045. Earnings per share are estimated at $0.27 per share compared to $0.21 in 1996.
Royale Investments specializes in supermarket properties.

"We are able to arrive at these figures because all Royale income is based on fixed long-term rentals," said president Vern Beck in a statement. "Expenses also can be calculated within a very tight range."
These projections are based on current 1997 property holdings, Royale Investments said. However, Beck added, management is actively working on additional acquisitions.
